> ** Important**: Security vulnerabilities must be reported **privately**.
> Do **not** open a public issue.

## How to report

Please use GitHub's private **Security Advisories** feature:

1. Go to: https://github.com/marco-spagn/pcmi/security/advisories/new
2. Fill in the details (scope, impact, reproduction steps)
3. Submit — this creates a private draft advisory visible only to maintainers

## After reporting

- We will acknowledge receipt within 48 hours (per [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/marco-spagn/pcmi/blob/main/SECURITY.md))
- We follow coordinated disclosure
- Credit is given unless you prefer anonymity

If you prefer email or another channel, see the security policy in `SECURITY.md`.

Thank you for helping keep PCMI secure.
